workflow.name: S14c_0A2 Sua bep buoi sang
workflow.description: Sửa ảnh bếp buổi sáng đã chọn: tải ảnh đó vào IMG_BEP_SANG_CU, chạy, chọn 1 ảnh làm BG_B_MORNING (dùng ở 0B và file 03, 04).

nodes.prompt: Edit Image 1, a photo of an empty kitchen in the morning. Keep everything else exactly as in Image 1: the same white cabinets, counter, double sink under the window, white gas range, range hood, cast-iron skillet, white crock of teal silicone utensils, paper towel holder, soap bottles, wall phone, fridge, floor, morning light, colors, camera position and framing. Change only these four things: 1) The paper hand fan hanging beside the wall phone: its printed side now shows a simple painting of a small white country church under a blue sky, with no people and no words, letters or writing anywhere on the fan. 2) The snapshots on the fridge door: replace every photo with snapshots of one Black American family, only adults: an older Black woman with short silver hair smiling with two church friends, a Black man in his forties with a salt-and-pepper beard beside his wife, and a young Black woman with long braids in a graduation cap; every person in every photo is Black American; keep the same number of photos, the same sizes, magnets and places, small and a little soft; the paper notes on the fridge are blank. 3) Remove the cereal boxes and everything else from the top of the fridge. 4) Add a white step trash can with a foot pedal and a lid on the floor at the end of the counter, lit by the same morning light, with a soft contact shadow on the floor. Looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors; no over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same kitchen as Image 1; only the fan picture, the fridge photos, the top of the fridge and the new trash can changed.
